card.name: Linking words before Parkinson's drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, including, of, such as, and the hyphenated -release, right before a Parkinson's drug name (pramipexole, ropinirole, carbidopa-levodopa, bromocriptine). Seen in dopamine agonist and levodopa label text.

modes.label: Linker before drug
modes.description: A preposition or phrase like with, including, of or such as that comes just before a named dopamine drug.
modes.example: Parkinson's disease patients being treated with dopaminergic agonists,<< including>> pramipexole dihydrochlor

modes.label: Immediate-release hyphen
modes.description: The -release part of immediate-release just before a drug name.
modes.example: compared immediate-release pramipexole tablets and immediate<<-release>> ropinirole.
